currentUse: Active diocesan Lithuanian Catholic parish; Lithuanian-language Masses Sundays and Fridays, English Mass Saturdays
summary: Divine Providence remains an open, functioning parish at 25335 W. Nine Mile Rd., Southfield, with a regular Lithuanian/English Mass schedule. It belongs to a four-parish Family of Parishes with Transfiguration, Our Lady of La Salette, and Our Mother of Perpetual Help. In the Archdiocese of Detroit's 2025–2027 restructuring, Divine Providence is in Planning Area 8, where three draft pastorate models remain under consideration. The Archdiocese describes the models as starting points and says no final decision has been made. The listening sessions and feedback period through July 31, 2026 have concluded; the published timeline calls for the archbishop's discernment in fall 2026, final plans in winter 2027, and implementation July 1, 2027.

developments.headline: Named among parishes that could lose weekend Mass
developments.detail: Detroit News reported that Divine Providence could stop holding weekend Mass under at least one proposed restructuring model; current Archdiocese materials place the parish in Planning Area 8 and state that no final decision has been made.

conflictsWithArchiveRecord: No contradictions. One refinement: the Detroit News list places Divine Providence in Planning Area 9 (southeastern Oakland County); a separate report grouped some Southfield parishes in Planning Area 8, so area assignment reporting varies slightly.
gaps: Could not independently confirm the parish's specific listening-session dates (2026-05-30 and 2026-06-06) or the March 2026 workbook — the official restructuring.aod.org site returned 403 and the parish site/bulletins do not mention restructuring. Unknown which specific model(s) would end weekend Mass at Divine Providence and whether the final plan (due winter 2027) will retain it. The original Detroit News article is paywalled; verified via two republications.
